title: A member can report a person, a comment or an event on the web
detail:
The web offered Report only on posts, Dispatches, guestbook notes and Market or Housing listings, while reportContent (app/(main)/feed/report-actions.ts) already accepts member, comment and event targets and the moderation queue already handles them. A member who saw a harmful comment, profile or event had no way to flag it from the web.

DONE 2026-11-18: a shared ReportLink (components/report-link.tsx) opens the same content report dialog and the same reportContent action the post menu uses, loaded on the first tap. It sits beside Block on a member profile (not your own), beside Reply on a comment (not your own), and beside Share on an event page (not for the host, a cohost or a manager). Signed-out viewers do not see it, the same as the post menu.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
